lines.en: label beachfive1:
scene black
Far across town, in a room you somehow haven’t seen yet despite this being the fourth chapter of the game...
lines.zh: 在城镇的另一端，在一间你不知怎么还没见过的房间里——尽管这已经是游戏的第四章了……

lines.en: : AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair1
: Your hair! Your beautiful hair! It’s gone! Who did this?! Do you have cancer?! Are you dying?! Because I don’t want to watch you die again, Ami! I love you! I’ll save you!
lines.zh: : 你的头发！你那漂亮的头发！没了！谁干的？！你得癌症了吗？！你要死了吗？！因为我不想再看着你死一次了，Ami！我爱你！我会救你的！

lines.en: : I love you too, Ayane. But I would love you more if you would stop sexually harassing me this early in the morning. Thank you for understanding.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你，Ayane。不过如果你能别一大早就对我性骚扰，我会更爱你。谢谢理解。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair2
: Also, when did you watch me die? Because I am very much alive despite having not felt that way at all in the several months before today.
lines.zh: : 还有，你什么时候看过我死了？因为我活得好好的，尽管在今天之前的几个月里我完全没有这种感觉。

lines.en: : Long story. Doesn’t matter. Is this what you look like now? Are you going through changes? Or did someone do this to you?
lines.zh: : 说来话长。不重要。你现在就是这个样子了吗？你是在经历什么转变？还是有人对你做了什么？

lines.en: : Sana’s mom did it.
lines.zh: : Sana 的妈妈剪的。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair3
: Sara?! Why?! She’s normally so pretty and nice! I’ve seen her a zillion times and she’s never cut off my hair! Why would she do that to you?!
lines.zh: : Sara？！为什么？！她平时又漂亮又温柔啊！我见过她无数次，她从来没剪过我的头发！她为什么要这么对你？！

lines.en: : She kind of had to. And I actually...kind of like it like this.
lines.zh: : 她算是不得已吧。而且我其实……还挺喜欢这个样子的。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair4
: And I save so much money on shampoo. Which you probably won’t understand since you’re rich. But, like, it’s seriously a lot.
lines.zh: : 而且我在洗发水上省了好多钱。你大概不懂，毕竟你有钱。不过，真的，省了特别多。

lines.en: : What about Sensei, though? He loved your long hair. That was the whole reason you kept growing it out, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那 Sensei 呢？他可是喜欢你的长发。那不就是你一直留长发的全部理由吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair5
: Yes. But I now know that Sensei will love me regardless of how I look.
lines.zh: : 是啊。但我现在知道了，不管我长什么样，Sensei 都会爱我。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
: Especially since he has already experienced how magical and wonderful having sex with me is and I don’t need to lure him in anymore.
lines.zh: : 尤其是他已经体验过跟我做爱有多么美妙、多么神奇，我再也不需要用什么去引诱他了。

lines.en: else:
: I just wish that he’d love me a little more physically. But, oh well. His room’s not going anywhere and I can still sneak in to get my fill of him whenever he isn’t home.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望他在肉体上能多爱我一点。不过算了。他的房间又不会跑，只要他不在家，我还是可以溜进去吃个够。

lines.en: : That was actually shaping up to be a really cute line until you went and ruined it.
lines.zh: : 那句话本来挺感人的，直到你亲手把它毁了。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair6

: Yeah, well...ruining things is kind of my specialty. Which is why I want to apologize for any weird stuff I may have said to you while Sensei was in a coma. But I don’t remember much of it, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧……毁掉东西算是我的专长。所以我想为 Sensei 昏迷期间可能对你说过的任何奇怪的话道歉。不过说实话我记不太清了。

lines.en: : It’s okay, Ami...I get that you and Sensei have a...complicated relationship. I just hope you don’t shut me out if something like this ever happens again.
lines.zh: : 没关系，Ami……我知道你和 Sensei 之间……关系很复杂。我只是希望以后再发生这种事时，你不要把我关在门外。

lines.en: : Just hit me next time. That’s what you did on the beach and that worked pretty well, didn’t it?
lines.zh: : 下次直接打我就行。你在海滩上就是这么做的，效果不是挺好的吗？

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair7
: Maybe a little. But you were still creepy as heck and clearly not as invested in our friendship as I was.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。可你那时候还是 creepy 得要命，而且明显没有我对这段友情那么投入。

lines.en: : Well, it’s hard to be invested in any friendship when the only person I ever think about is my dad.
lines.zh: : 嗯，当我脑子里唯一想的人只有我爸爸的时候，很难对任何友情投入。

lines.en: : I’m talking about Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我说的是 Sensei。

lines.en: : I figured, but you accidentally called him “Dad” so-
lines.zh: : 我猜到了，可你刚才不小心叫他「爸爸」了，所以——

lines.en: : That wasn’t an accident. That’s just what I call him now.
lines.zh: : 那不是不小心。我现在就是这么叫他的。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair8
: Mutually, of course! We had a serious talk about how we really see one another and...that’s kind of just where we landed.
lines.zh: : 当然是双向的！我们认真谈过对彼此的真实看法，然后……差不多就落到这个结果了。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair9
: I’m really happy for you, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我真为你高兴，Ami。

lines.en: : Thanks, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Ayane。

lines.en: : I just hope you know that this means I’m going to call him Dad too from now on since he’s been watching over me pretty much just as long as you.
lines.zh: : 我只希望你知道，这意味着从现在起我也要叫他爸爸了，毕竟他照顾我的时间差不多跟你一样长。

lines.en: : Do it. We can be sisters.
lines.zh: : 叫吧。我们可以当姐妹。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair10
: Wait, for real? I didn’t think you’d agree to that so easily.
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？我没想到你这么容易就答应了。

lines.en: : I’m a changed girl, Ayane. Even if I don’t look like one anymore.
lines.zh: : 我变了一个人了，Ayane。哪怕我看起来不再像了。

lines.en: : What does this mean for Maya then? Are we converting the entire Sensei Love Squad into the Sensei Love Sisterhood? Are we just a big, incestuous family now?
lines.zh: : 那对 Maya 来说意味着什么？我们要把整个「Sensei 后援团」改组成「Sensei 后援姐妹会」吗？我们现在是一个乱伦大家庭了吗？

lines.en: : Nah. Maya can stay Maya, but you can be my sister. Just don’t tell her I said that. I don’t want her getting jealous.
lines.zh: : 不。Maya 就还是 Maya，但你可以当我姐妹。不过别跟她说是我说的。我可不想她吃醋。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair11
: Hey, where is she anyway? I thought she was coming over today too?
lines.zh: : 对了，她人呢？我还以为她今天也要过来？

lines.en: : Maya? I’ve got no idea.
lines.zh: : Maya？我完全不知道。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair12
: Pants off now, asshole! We’ve got approximately one hour before Ayane starts asking me where I am and I am not letting it go to waste!
lines.zh: : 现在把裤子脱了，混蛋！距离 Ayane 开始问我在哪儿大概还有一个小时，我可不想把它浪费掉！

lines.en: : Why are you here?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么在这儿？……

lines.en: : Because men aren’t the only ones with needs!
lines.zh: : 因为不止男人有需求啊！

lines.en: : Yeah, but how did you even get in?
lines.zh: : 是，可你到底怎么进来的？

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair13

: I know where you keep the spare key, obviously. And I even made sure to show up when Ami isn’t home so we can be as loud as we want and not risk getting caught. Plus, I brought your favorite costume.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道你把备用钥匙藏哪儿。而且我还特意挑了 Ami 不在的时候来，这样我们想多大声就多大声，不用担心被抓。另外，我把你最喜欢的那套 cos 带来了。

lines.en: : Are you seriously going to look at me in all of my adorable miko glory and refuse sex with me? Is this what we’ve become?
lines.zh: : 你真的要看着我这一身可爱的巫女打扮，然后拒绝跟我做爱吗？我们之间已经变成这样了吗？

lines.en: : We haven’t become anything. We aren’t anything. I don’t know you and I don’t want you here.
lines.zh: : 我们没变成什么。我们什么都不是。我不认识你，也不想你来这儿。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair14
: Okay. Well, I know you.
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过，我认识你。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair15
: And I’m kind of like, in love with you or whatever,
lines.zh: : 而且我……大概、算是爱上你了吧，还是什么的，

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair16
: Come on, Sensei...I said the thing. You know how hard that is for me.
lines.zh: : 拜托，Sensei……我都把那句话说出口了。你知道那对我来说有多难。

lines.en: : Don’t I deserve, like...a reward or something?
lines.zh: : 我难道不该得到点……奖励什么的吗？

lines.en: : Listen, I...
lines.zh: : 听着，我……

lines.en: : This is getting kind of...weird.
lines.zh: : 这变得有点……奇怪了。

lines.en: : Like, I still don’t even know if I did something or...if there’s something I can do...but, like...
lines.zh: : 比如，我到现在都不知道我是做错了什么，还是……有什么我能做的……但是，比如……

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair17
: What if I get on top this time?
lines.zh: : 那这次换我在上面怎么样？

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair18
: Thanks, Geoffrey! You’re the best!
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Geoffrey！你最棒了！

lines.en: : And good luck in Antarctica! I’m sure your precious family heirlooms will turn up in no time at all!
lines.zh: : 祝你在南极洲好运！我相信你家传的宝贝很快就会出现的！

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair19
: It’s crazy how he got permission to leave the city, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 他居然能拿到离开这座城市的许可，真是疯了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I wish we could go with him. Never underestimate Geoffrey’s connections, I guess.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我真希望能跟他一起去。看来永远别低估 Geoffrey 的人脉。

lines.en: : I just hope the Black Panthers don’t get involved this time. He has enough on his plate without them.
lines.zh: : 我只希望这次黑豹党别掺和进来。他手上的事已经够多了，别再加上他们。

lines.en: : If anyone can handle an extra plate, it’s Geoffrey.
lines.zh: : 如果说有谁能多端一个盘子，那肯定是 Geoffrey。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair20
: So! You put any thought into when you’ll be coming back to school yet? Or are you still trying to lie low for the indefinite future?
lines.zh: : 那么！你想过什么时候回学校了吗？还是说你打算就这么无限期地低调下去？

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair21
: Ugh...I don’t know. Sensei says I-
lines.zh: : 呃……我不知道。Sensei 说我——

lines.en: : Dad.
lines.zh: : 爸爸。

lines.en: : Dad says it’s fine for me to spend as much time as I need at home, but I feel really bad about how much...attention I’ve been getting, you know?
lines.zh: : 爸爸说我想在家待多久都行，可是我对自己得到的……关注感到很过意不去，你懂吧？

lines.en: : No, actually. That sounds like the exact opposite of what the Ami I know would say.
lines.zh: : 不，其实不懂。这听起来跟我所认识的 Ami 会说的正好相反。

lines.en: : Okay, like...yeah. I love it. But I don’t want to feel like a burden anymore, Ayane. And I also don’t want to have to deal with the rest of the girls in class.
lines.zh: : 好吧，比如……对，我乐在其中。可我不想再觉得自己是个负担了，Ayane。而且我也不想应付班上其他的女生。

lines.en: : It was weird enough just going back to the maid cafe. And Chika clearly hates me, so...that’s one shit-list I don’t want to be on.
lines.zh: : 光是回女仆咖啡馆就已经够怪了。而且 Chika 明显讨厌我，所以……那份黑名单我可不想上。

lines.en: if ayanecthree == True:
: Well, I’m not really Chika’s biggest fan either. So if it comes down to picking sides, you’ll have me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也不算是 Chika 的粉丝。所以真要选边站的话，我站你。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair22
: What happened with you and Chika?
lines.zh: : 你和 Chika 之间怎么了？

lines.en: : Way more than I’d like to admit. But that’s not a thing I really want to talk about with you.
lines.zh: : 比我想承认的要多得多。不过这不是我想跟你聊的事。

lines.en: : I’m confused.
lines.zh: : 我不明白。

lines.en: else:
: Chika seems to have a problem with anyone that spends time with Sensei, so I’m sure she doesn’t like me either.
lines.zh: : Chika 似乎对任何跟 Sensei 走得近的人都有意见，所以我觉得她肯定也不喜欢我。

lines.en: : You really think so?
lines.zh: : 你真这么想？

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair23
: Ami, don’t worry about what the other girls think. I think most people understand that none of that came from the heart.
lines.zh: : Ami，别在意其他女生怎么想。我觉得大多数人都明白，那些话不是出自真心的。

lines.en: : I mean...it kind of did, though.
lines.zh: : 我意思是……其实还挺真心的。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair24
: Like, maybe not the violent parts of it, but I still don’t want anybody else getting close to my dad. Nor do I want them pretending that they’re not already doing that behind my back.
lines.zh: : 比如，也许暴力的部分不算，但我还是不想让任何人靠近我爸爸。也不想她们一边做着那种事，一边假装自己没在我背后做。

lines.en: : You’re fine, though. You can keep having sex with him if you want.
lines.zh: : 不过你没关系。你想跟他上床就继续上。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair25
: Ami!
lines.zh: : Ami！

lines.en: : What? It’s not like I didn’t already know about you two. Plus, if he’s going to sleep with anyone not named Ami Arakawa, I’d want it to be you because you actually love him.
lines.zh: : 怎么？我又不是不知道你们俩的事。再说，如果他要跟一个不叫 Ami Arakawa 的人睡觉，我希望那是你，因为你是真的爱他。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair26
: I...yeah. But that’s still a weird thing to say to my face.
lines.zh: : 我……是啊。可当着我的面说这种话，还是挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : I’ve said much weirder stuff to your face, Ayane. Like this — why don’t I watch you two sometime? Just to make sure you’re doing it right.
lines.zh: : 我当着你的面说过更奇怪的话呢，Ayane。比如这句——要不哪天我看看你们俩？就为了确保你们做得对。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair27
: Ami! Stop it!
lines.zh: : Ami！别说了！

lines.en: : I bought a few of Niki’s light sticks online a while back. Maybe I could wave them around and cheer you guys on if you won’t let me in on the action?
lines.zh: : 我前段时间在网上买了几根 Niki 的荧光棒。要是你们不让我加入，也许我可以在旁边挥着给你们加油？

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair28
: Why would you even want in on the action? We don’t see each other that way.
lines.zh: : 你为什么想加入啊？我们又不是那样看彼此的。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
: Yeah, but we see Dad that way. Right, sis?
lines.zh: : 是，可我们都是那样看爸爸的。对吧，姐妹？

lines.en: : I feel so uncomfortable right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在感觉超不舒服。

lines.en: else:
: I’d take anything at this point, to be honest. And if a threesome is required for me to fuck my father, a threesome I shall have.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我现在什么都愿意接受。如果为了能跟我爸爸上床非得来个三人行，那我就来个三人行。

lines.en: : I feel so uncomfortable right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在感觉超不舒服。

lines.en: : I’m not trying to make you uncomfortable, Ayane. I really don’t mind the two of you being more than just...what you’ve been the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 我不是想让你不舒服，Ayane。我真的不介意你们俩不只是……我人生中其余时间里那样的关系。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair29
: You’re just saying that. And you’re being creepy again.
lines.zh: : 你只是嘴上说说而已。而且你又变态起来了。

lines.en: : Are you gonna hit me?
lines.zh: : 你要打我吗？

lines.en: : I feel like I should just to snap you out of it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我该打，好把你打醒。

lines.en: : Okay, just not too hard. I don’t want Sensei seeing any black eyes and getting worried.
lines.zh: : 好吧，只是别太用力。我可不想让 Sensei 看到黑眼圈然后担心。

lines.en: : How long have you known?
lines.zh: : 你知道多久了？

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair30
: A while, I guess. But I had a hard time accepting it until I looked through his phone and understood the gravity of everything.
lines.zh: : 有一阵子了吧，我想。不过在我翻了他手机、明白了一切有多严重之前，我一直很难接受。
: 我……明白了……

lines.en: : Yeah, so I’m pretty fucking miserable now. That’s fun.
lines.zh: : 是啊，所以我现在他妈的惨透了。真有意思。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair31
: Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: : It is what it is, you know? He’s the ideal man.
lines.zh: : 事情就是这样，你懂吧？他是理想的男人。

lines.en: : Caring...handsome...mysterious...handsome. Thinking everyone else would just ignore that for my sake is delusional when no one even likes me. Oh, and did I mention how handsome he is?
lines.zh: : 体贴……英俊……神秘……英俊。以为别人会为了我而对他视而不见，简直是妄想，何况根本没人喜欢我。哦，我提过他有多英俊了吗？

lines.en: : Plenty of people like you, Ami.
lines.zh: : 喜欢你的人多了去了，Ami。

lines.en: : Not enough to not fuck my dad, I guess. Like, just look at you. You like me more than anybody and you’d still choose him over me. And you’d be right.
lines.zh: : 大概还没多到不跟我爸爸上床吧。就像，看看你。你比任何人都喜欢我，可你还是会选他而不是我。而且你选得没错。

lines.en: : Ami, I don’t want to choose between you two.
lines.zh: : Ami，我不想在你们俩之间做选择。

lines.en: : Threesome it is, then.
lines.zh: : 那就三人行吧。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair32
: I don’t want to have a threesome either!
lines.zh: : 我也不想搞三人行啊！

lines.en: : Well, now my feelings are just hurt.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那现在我的感情受伤了。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair33
: Ami...are you really okay with Sensei-
lines.zh: : Ami……你真的不介意 Sensei——

lines.en: : Dad.
lines.zh: : 爸爸。

lines.en: : Are you really okay with...Dad and me being together?
lines.zh: : 你真的不介意……爸爸和我在一起？

lines.en: : I’m confused. Are you, like...asking for my blessing? Because you sure haven’t needed it so far.
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。你这是……在求我的祝福吗？因为到目前为止你显然都不需要。

lines.en: : Maybe I am. I’m not really sure. But with you, it’s...
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。我也不确定。但跟你，这……

lines.en: : I know you’re smarter than you let on. And I don’t want this to be the sort of friendship where you’re only pretending to like me because you’re getting something out of it.
lines.zh: : 我知道你比你表现出来的聪明。我不想让我们的友情变成你只是因为有好处才假装喜欢我。

lines.en: : With all due respect, Ayane...what exactly do I get from you? There’s no benefit to be gained from your friendship apart from just...being your friend. But that’s all I want, really.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，Ayane……我从你这儿到底能得到什么？除了就……当你的朋友，你的友情没有任何好处可图。可那其实正是我唯一想要的。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair34
: Maya would never admit she’s sleeping with Sensei to my face. I even gave her the chance to the other day and she completely dropped the ball. At least you’re open with your love.
lines.zh: : Maya 绝不会当面承认她在跟 Sensei 睡觉。前几天我甚至给过她机会，结果她彻底搞砸了。至少你对自己的爱是坦荡的。

lines.en: : And that’s good. Because that’s the type of love Dad needs. He needs someone with feelings so powerful that they wouldn’t dare be kept secret in the name of preserving some other relationship.
lines.zh: : 而那很好。因为那正是爸爸需要的那种爱。他需要一个人，感情强烈到不愿为了保全别的关系而把它们藏在心里。

lines.en: : I can do that. You can do that. Niki and Noriko can probably do that. But Maya? She’d never admit it to anyone. Hell, I’d be surprised if she’s even admitted how she feels to herself.
lines.zh: : 我能做到。你能做到。Niki 和 Noriko 大概也能做到。可 Maya？她永远不会对任何人承认。操，要是她连对自己都承认过，我反倒会惊讶。

lines.en: : Sorry. I know this isn’t the kind of conversation you had in mind when you invited me over today. I just felt weird hiding stuff from you.
lines.zh: : 对不起。我知道你今天叫我过来，想聊的不是这种话题。我只是觉得瞒着你事情很别扭。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair35
: I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: : I’d appreciate it if you’d make him wear a condom, though. I don’t want to babysit a child my dad made without me.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你能让他戴套，我会很感激。我可不想去带一个我爸爸背着我和别人生的孩子。

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair36
: So, uhh...video games.
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……打游戏吧。

lines.en: : Sorry again. I’m not really good at “being open.”
lines.zh: : 再次抱歉。我不太擅长「敞开心扉」。

lines.en: : You’re fine, I just...
lines.zh: : 你没事，只是……

lines.en: : Don’t trust me...right?
lines.zh: : 不信任我……对吧？

lines.en: scene ayaneamihair37
: I don’t blame you, Ayane. I wouldn’t trust me either. But...
lines.zh: : 我不怪你，Ayane。换我我也不信任我。可是……

lines.en: : I hope you can trust me more than the person ditching us right now to do exactly what we both wish we were doing.
lines.zh: : 我希望你能比我更信任那个人——她现在正丢下我们，去做我们俩都希望自己在做的事。
